step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identifies entry routing with Amazon Route 53 distributing traffic using weighted policies (100% active region, 0% secondary region).
2. Traffic reaches the Application Load Balancer (ALB) which distributes incoming requests to active compute services (ECS and EC2).
3. Amazon ECS manages containerized auxiliary applications, pulling images from ECR and interacting with RDS databases.
4. Core stock exchange matching systems run on EC2 and RDS.
5. Cross-region disaster recovery mechanisms replicate state from EC2 (snapshots via Data Lifecycle Manager), RDS (cross-region read replicas), and ECR (container image replication) into the secondary AWS region.
6. Amazon DynamoDB uses native Global Tables for automatic multi-region replication without requiring manual cross-region arrows.
